checks.note: Fetched page confirms Bearer secret token for custom apps, public token for public data only, and OAuth 2.0 for public apps (a real API-access flow). The changelog confirms the POST token endpoint with the listed params and that the GET query-param method no longer works. The page does not mention token expiry, so the 'tokens do not expire' remark is unverified; I removed it from the notes.

Page says 'Only stores on paid plans can access API' and offers a free upgrade for a test store via Ecwid support. paid_plan is correct. The 'custom app is created automatically' detail was not checked.
REST API reference covers store profile, orders, products, customers, categories and discounts, and states a 600 requests/min per token limit. No GraphQL is mentioned. Breadth is broad.

llms.txt states only that the docs can be searched through an MCP server. A search found only third-party store MCPs (Zapier, viaSocket, Vinkius, Truto, Unified.to) and no official store-operations MCP. none_found stands.
ready_with_caveats follows from the paid-plan requirement and the lack of an official store MCP. The blocker text is accurate.

corrected.one_liner: Ecwid (by Lightspeed) is a hosted e-commerce platform that adds an online store to existing websites and social/marketplace channels.
corrected.auth_notes: Custom app (single store): copy the secret token from the app dashboard and send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header. A public token exists for public store data only. Public/external apps use OAuth 2.0: authorization code exchanged via POST to https://my.ecwid.com/api/oauth/token with client_id, client_secret, code, redirect_uri and grant_type=authorization_code. The old GET/query-param method no longer works (changed March 2025). Token expiry is not documented on the pages checked.
corrected.access_notes: The setup page says "Only stores on paid plans can access API." Ecwid offers a free upgrade to a paid plan for integration testing on a non-production store, store customization projects, public App Market apps and Instant Site templates. For a test store, you email Ecwid support.
corrected.blocker: API needs a paid store plan (a free upgrade for testing can be requested from support). Rate limit is 600 requests/min per token. The only vendor MCP is a docs-search MCP (https://docs.ecwid.com/~gitbook/mcp), not a store-operations server. Third-party MCP connectors exist (Zapier, viaSocket, Vinkius, Truto, Unified.to), unverified.

evidence.auth: https://docs.ecwid.com/get-started/make-your-first-api-request (Bearer secret token, public token, OAuth 2.0 for public apps); https://docs.ecwid.com/changelog/march-2025/march-20/oauth-for-public-apps-get-request-type-changed-to-post (OAuth POST token endpoint)
